root.label: Benjamin William Day pleads guilty to Maria Saceanu murder

events.label: Benjamin William Day pleads guilty to Maria Saceanu murder

slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: A forensic science student obsessed with the US television drama Dexter has admitted murdering a 24-year-old woman after luring her to a plastic-lined "kill room" inside an Airbnb.

slots.name: defendant age
slots.sentence: Benjamin William Day, 20, changed his plea to guilty on the second day of his trial at Wolverhampton Crown Court.

slots.name: date of murder
slots.sentence: Prosecutors said he had carefully planned the killing of Maria Saceanu on 20 December, preparing a room with plastic sheeting and items intended to help him murder her and dispose of evidence.

slots.name: number of knife wounds
slots.sentence: The first day of the trial heard that after causing 78 knife wounds to sex worker Saceanu, who he contacted through a website using a burner phone, Day abandoned the "gruesome task" of dismemberment because he cut himself.

slots.name: 999 call time
slots.sentence: Prosecutors claim Day left the Airbnb after the killing, walked some distance away, and called 999 at 00:50 on 21 December asking for medical help.
